previous_statement: Coarse-to-sharp C*-norm bootstrap and conclusion. Use the following elementary uniform lemma. If W:D->E is a star-preserving d-homomorphism from an exact C*-algebra to an epsilon-C*-algebra and c||z||<=||Wz||<=C||z|| with fixed 0<c<=C, then, for d+epsilon small, (1-K_b(d+epsilon))||z||<=||Wz||<=(1+K_b(d+epsilon))||z||, where K_b depends only on c,C. Indeed normalize ||z||=1, put z_0=z, z_{m+1}=z_m^dagger z_m, so ||z_m||=1, and a_m=||Wz_m|| lies in [c,C]. Multiplicative defect and the target C*-bounds give (1-epsilon)a_m^2-d<=a_{m+1}<=(1+epsilon)a_m^2+d. Hence |log a_{m+1}-2log a_m|<=K_0(d+epsilon). Iterating, dividing by 2^N, and letting N->infinity (the bounded term 2^{-N}log a_N vanishes) yields |log a_0|<=K_0(d+epsilon), which exponentiates to the claimed 1+/-K_b(d+epsilon) bounds after a universal threshold reduction. Apply this to every V_n using nodes 1.2.1 and 1.2.2 with d=K_alg*t and epsilon<=t. Thus all V_n satisfy the same K_inc*t homomorphism and two-sided norm clauses, and V_n=I_n tensor V by construction, proving node 1.2.
new_statement: Uniform coarse-to-sharp C*-norm bootstrap. Let 0<c<=C be fixed. There are constants eta_b>0 and K_b<infinity, depending only on c,C, such that the following holds. If W:D->E is a star-preserving d-homomorphism from an exact C*-algebra D to an epsilon-C*-algebra E, c||z||<=||Wz||<=C||z|| for all z, and eta=d+epsilon<=eta_b, then (1-K_b*eta)||z||<=||Wz||<=(1+K_b*eta)||z|| for all z. Proof: by homogeneity take ||z||=1, define z_0=z and z_{m+1}=z_m^dagger z_m, and put a_m=||Wz_m||. Exactness of D gives ||z_m||=1, hence c<=a_m<=C. Star preservation, the d-homomorphism estimate, and the target product/C*-axioms give (1-epsilon)a_m^2-d<=a_{m+1}<=(1+epsilon)a_m^2+d. Since a_m>=c, if eta is small enough then a_{m+1}/a_m^2 lies in [1-K_1*eta,1+K_1*eta], with K_1 depending only on c; therefore r_m=log(a_{m+1})-2log(a_m) satisfies |r_m|<=K_2*eta uniformly in m. Writing b_m=log(a_m), iteration yields b_0=2^(-N)b_N-sum_{m=0}^{N-1}2^(-m-1)r_m. Since b_N is uniformly bounded by max{|log c|,|log C|}, letting N tend to infinity gives |log(a_0)|<=K_2*eta. After decreasing eta_b, exponentiation gives 1-K_b*eta<=a_0<=1+K_b*eta. Rescaling proves the assertion for arbitrary z (with z=0 immediate).
